# Boot Barn

> Boot Barn is the nation's leading lifestyle retailer of western and work-related footwear, apparel and accessories for men, women and children.

## Key Sections

- [Men's Western & Workwear](https://www.bootbarn.com/mens): Cowboy boots, hats, apparel, and accessories for men.
- [Women's Western & Workwear](https://www.bootbarn.com/womens): Cowgirl boots, fashion apparel, and accessories for women.
- [Kids' Western & Workwear](https://www.bootbarn.com/kids): Boots and clothing for children and toddlers.
- [Work Boots & Clothing](https://www.bootbarn.com/workwear): Heavy-duty, safety-toe, and flame-resistant workwear.
- [Shop by Brand](https://www.bootbarn.com/brands): Browse all brands carried including Ariat, Wrangler, and Justin.
- [Sale Items](https://www.bootbarn.com/sale): Discounted footwear, apparel, and clearance items.

## Programs & Services

- [B Rewarded Program](https://www.bootbarn.com/rewards): Boot Barn's customer loyalty and rewards program.
- [Gift Cards](https://www.bootbarn.com/gift-cards): Purchase physical and eGift cards.
- [Military Discount](https://www.bootbarn.com/military-discount.html): Information on discounts for active military and veterans.
- [Boot Barn App](https://www.bootbarn.com/app.html): Download the mobile app for iOS and Android.

## Customer Service & Support

- [Customer Service & Contact Us](https://www.bootbarn.com/cs-home): General help, contact information, and FAQs.
- [Order Status](https://www.bootbarn.com/orderstatus): Look up the shipping and processing status of an order.
- [Returns & Exchanges](https://www.bootbarn.com/returns): Policies and instructions for returning or exchanging items.
- [Shipping Information](https://www.bootbarn.com/shipping): Shipping methods, delivery times, and costs.

## Corporate Information

- [About Boot Barn](https://www.bootbarn.com/about-us): Company history and core values.
- [Store Locator](https://www.bootbarn.com/stores): Find a physical Boot Barn retail location.
- [Careers](https://careers.bootbarn.com/): Job openings and employment information.
- [Investor Relations](https://investor.bootbarn.com/): Financial reports, stock information, and corporate governance.

## Social Media & Community

- [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/bootbarnofficial/): Official Boot Barn Instagram.
- [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/BootBarn/): Official Boot Barn Facebook page.
- [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/user/BootBarn): Official Boot Barn YouTube channel.

## Optional

- [Privacy Policy](https://www.bootbarn.com/privacy-policy): Information on how user data is collected and used.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.bootbarn.com/terms-of-use): Legal terms for using the Boot Barn website.
- [Sitemap](https://www.bootbarn.com/sitemap_index.xml): XML sitemap for programmatic crawling of the site.
